about.title: About Hout-Shop
about.subtitle: Passion for Oak
about.description: For generations, we have been bringing the warmth and beauty of oak wood to your home and projects. Our Belgian family business guarantees craftsmanship, fair prices and personal service.
about.storyText: Hout-Shop was born from a deep passion for wood. As a Belgian family business, we combine traditional craftsmanship with modern techniques to deliver oak panels of the highest quality. From our workshop in Belgium, we ship throughout Belgium and the Netherlands.
about.qualityText: Every panel is carefully selected and inspected. We work exclusively with certified wood from sustainably managed forests.
about.sustainableText: We believe in responsible management of our forests. All our wood is FSC or PEFC certified.
about.expertiseText: Years of experience in the wood sector guarantee that you always receive the best quality.
